name: Required fields block an incomplete order
description: Confirms the new order wizard will not advance past a step whose required fields are empty, and that it says so.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as retail@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Retail/NewOrder. This is a four step wizard: Service, Customer, Installation, Account. The Customer step carries the required Full Name, Mobile Number and CNIC fields
On step 1, select a connection type, a plan and a billing cycle, then click Next to reach the Customer step
Assert the Customer step is now shown and its Full Name field is empty
With the Customer step fields left empty, click Next

Assert the wizard does not advance past the Customer step. Evidence of the block is either an inline message next to the empty fields or a visible warning notice. If the Installation step appears instead, this test must fail.
Navigate away to /Retail/Dashboard, then back to /Retail/NewOrder and click Next on step 1 without selecting anything
Assert the wizard either blocks on step 1 or advances to step 2, but in neither case creates an order
